sys_update_set.name: Exclude Escalation from Require Update BR
sys_update_set.description: Skips clearing u_require_update (and satisfying Update SLA) when case work notes are written by the Escalate Case flow (EscalationUtils.appendNote). Updates BR "Update Required Update field".

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_customerservice_case</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_customerservice_case">state=10^stateVALCHANGES^ORcommentsVALCHANGES^ORwork_notesVALCHANGES^EQ<item display_value="Open" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="10"/><item endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="comments" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="true" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="work_notes" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="true" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Update Required Update field</name><order>200</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {
    if (current.sys_updated_by != current.opened_by.user_name) {
        if ((previous.state == "1" && current.state == "10") &&
            (current.u_require_update == false)) {
            var gr = new GlideRecord("sn_customerservice_case");
            if (gr.get(current.getUniqueValue())) {
                gr.u_require_update = true;
                gr.update();
            }

        } else if ((current.sys_updated_by != "system") && (previous.state != "18") && !(current.u_next_update_due_duration.changes())) {
            // Do not clear Require Update / satisfy Update SLA for escalation-driven notes
            var wn = current.work_notes.getJournalEntry(1) || '';
            var isEscalationNote = current.work_notes.changes() &&
                (wn.indexOf('has requested to escalate this') > -1 ||
                    wn.indexOf('has been approved') > -1 ||
                    wn.indexOf('has approved escalation') > -1 ||
                    wn.indexOf('has declined escalation') > -1 ||
                    wn.indexOf('has been closed') > -1 ||
                    (wn.indexOf('Escalation ') > -1 && wn.indexOf('has updated:') > -1) ||
                    wn.indexOf('phase has changed') > -1 ||
                    wn.indexOf('trend has changed') > -1);

            if (!isEscalationNote) {
                var gr = new GlideRecord("sn_customerservice_case");
                if (gr.get(current.getUniqueValue())) {
                    gr.u_require_update = false;
                    gr.update();
                }
            }
            // var grSLA = new GlideRecord("task_sla");
            // grSLA.addEncodedQuery('task=' + current.sys_id + '^sla.target=update^stage=in_progress');
            // grSLA.query();
            // if (grSLA.next()) { // 
            //     grSLA.stage = 'completed';
            //     grSLA.update();
            // }.

        }
        if (current.priority.changes() && current.u_require_update == false) {
            var grCase = new GlideRecord("sn_customerservice_case");
            if (grCase.get(current.getUniqueValue())) {
                grCase.u_require_update = true;
                grCase.update();
            }
            var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_trigger');
            gr.addEncodedQuery("nameLIKE" + current.number + "^state=0^job_context=" + current.sys_id);
            gr.query();
            if (gr.next()) {
                gr.deleteRecord();

            }
        }
        if (previous.state == "18" && current.state == "10" && current.u_require_update == false) {
            var grCase = new GlideRecord("sn_customerservice_case");
            if (grCase.get(current.getUniqueValue())) {
                grCase.u_require_update = true;
                grCase.update();
            }
            var gr = new GlideRecord('sys_trigger');
            gr.addEncodedQuery("nameLIKE" + current.number + "^state=0^job_context=" + current.sys_id);
            gr.query();
            if (gr.next()) {
                gr.deleteRecord();

            }
        }
    }
})(current, previous);
